The '''1992–93 Ekstraklasa''' (then known as '''[[I liga]]''') was the 58th season of [[Sports league|the highest tier domestic division]] in the [[Polish football league system]] since its establishment in [[1927 Ekstraklasa|1927]].

It was contested by 18 teams. [[Siarka Tarnobrzeg]] made their first Ekstraklasa appearance in the club's history.<ref>[http://www.90minut.pl/sezony.php?id_klub=347 Sezony - Siarka Tarnobrzeg at 90minut.pl]</ref>

{{more|Sunday of Miracles}}
[[Lech Poznań]] successfully defended their title after two final day games ([[Wisła Kraków]] vs [[Legia Warsaw]] 0–6; [[ŁKS Łódź]] vs [[Olimpia Poznań]] 7–1) had been cancelled due to allegations of "unsportsmanlike conduct during the game".<ref>[http://www.90minut.pl/liga/0/liga579.html 90minut.pl]</ref> Known colloquially as "[[Sunday of Miracles|The Sunday of Miracles]]", [[UEFA]] subsequently disqualified Polish clubs from the [[1993–94 UEFA Cup]].
